messages:
emma: quick check  manager wants a 15% comp adjustment for an IC who took on product-ownership duties last month. what's the minimal evidence we need to file?
raj: Manager should attach a short evidence doc: 3 bullets (new responsibilities, key deliverables, customer impact) + manager endorsement. link to template: promo-evidence-template (Drive).
tiffany: Also include the org chart snippet showing the role change and the HRIS employee id. helps avoid manual corrections in Workday.
luke: For approvals: manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops for standard. If annualized delta > $12k then Director+ signoff needed. If crossing grade, route includes People Ops director.
emma: Manager asks if peer notes are required. they don't have formal peer reviews.
raj: Peer notes optional but helpful. prioritize concrete examples over letters.
emma: And retro pay? manager wants backpay to the date duties shifted (4 weeks ago). is that allowed?
luke: Retro allowed but exceptional. Finance prefers retro <= 60 days; backpay > 30 days needs CFO approval. Flag as "retro" on the form so payroll queues it correctly.
emma: How fast can we hit the next payroll? payroll date is in 9 business days.
payroll-bot: Automated check: if form + all approvals + cost center are submitted >= 5 business days before payroll close, likely in next run. missing items will delay.
tiffany: If timing is tight, tag PRIORITY in the form subject and ping @people-ops-review. include GL code and cost center to speed Finance allocation.
emma: Should equity refresh be submitted alongside this? manager prefers a single packet.
raj: Equity is separate. submit via comp-ops workflow; don't combine with comp-change form. mixing causes routing delays.
emma: thanks — i'll resubmit with the three-bullet evidence, org chart, HRIS id, and priority tag. will ping if anything blocks.
luke: Note for playbook: include sample evidence bullets and org chart snippet. saving this thread for reference.
